correctness.rationale: Cayley-Hamilton for a primitive matrix U over R_m yields U^3=(tau^2-delta)U-tau delta I; unit minor of (I,U) makes this equivalent to delta=tau^2 and tau^3=0. Exactly q^2-1 nonzero nilpotent residue matrices; q^{m-ceil(m/3)} traces and q^{2(m-1)} fixed-trace/determinant lifts yield P_m=(q^2-1)q^{3m-2-ceil(m/3)}. At entry valuation v<c, lifting each of four coordinates by 2v levels gives q^{8v}P_{s-3v}, independent of v. At >=c cubes vanish automatically. Verified separately for small Z/p^s rings with direct matrix multiplication; extension fields and all s established by proof, not finite experiment. For s=1 cubic equals square nilpotence and c=1; zero/deep block handled.
